questions.def: Use 'would have' for future in the past after 'said'.
questions.question: He said he ___ finished the report by then.

questions.def: Use 'whether' in reported questions when there are two options.
questions.question: She asked me ___ I had seen the movie.

questions.def: Don't use 'that' directly after 'told' when reporting a statement.
questions.question: He told that he was tired yesterday.

questions.def: 'Deny' is followed by a gerund (verb + -ing).
questions.question: She ___ stealing the money.

questions.def: Use 'had' to report past perfect continuous actions.
questions.question: They claimed they ___ been working on the project for months.

questions.def: 'Suggest' is followed by a gerund.
questions.question: He suggested ___ to the museum.

questions.def: Use 'told' when reporting to someone; 'said' requires 'to'.
questions.question: She said me that she was busy.

questions.def: 'Warn against' requires past simple in reported speech.
questions.question: The doctor ___ him against smoking.

questions.def: Use past continuous for actions in progress at a past time.
questions.question: She explained that the train ___ leaving in five minutes.

questions.def: 'Wondered' often introduces an indirect question with 'when'.
questions.question: He wondered ___ she would arrive.

questions.def: Use 'asked us to help' or 'asked if we would help'.
questions.question: They asked that we help them later.

questions.def: 'Insist on' requires past simple in reported speech.
questions.question: He ___ on paying for dinner.

questions.def: Use 'had' to report past simple actions further in the past.
questions.question: The report stated the company ___ made a profit last year.

questions.def: 'Confirm' is often followed by 'that' introducing a clause.
questions.question: She confirmed ___ she would be there.

questions.def: Omit 'me' after 'mentioned'. Use 'He mentioned that...'
questions.question: He mentioned me that he was leaving.

questions.def: 'Promise to' requires past simple in reported speech.
questions.question: He ___ to call me back later.

questions.def: Use 'had' to report past perfect actions further in the past.
questions.question: The witness testified that he ___ seen the accident.

questions.def: 'Inquire about' is the correct prepositional phrase.
questions.question: She inquired ___ the price of the item.

questions.def: 'Advise' requires past simple in reported speech.
questions.question: The lawyer ___ her not to sign the contract.

questions.def: Use 'had' to report past perfect actions further in the past.
questions.question: He recounted how he ___ escaped from the burning building.

questions.def: 'Demand' is followed by 'to' + infinitive.
questions.question: She demanded ___ speak to the manager.

questions.def: Use 'told' when reporting to someone; 'said' requires 'to'.
questions.question: They said me they would be late.

questions.def: 'Accuse of' requires past simple in reported speech.
questions.question: They ___ him of stealing the car.

questions.def: Use 'didn't' to report past simple negative actions.
questions.question: She implied that she ___ know the answer.

questions.def: 'Remind someone to' + infinitive is the correct structure.
questions.question: He reminded me ___ my keys.

questions.def: 'Urge' requires past simple in reported speech.
questions.question: He ___ them to reconsider their decision.

questions.def: Use past continuous to report actions in progress at a past time.
questions.question: The news reported that the storm ___ causing significant damage.

questions.def: Use 'what' in exclamations in reported speech.
questions.question: She exclaimed ___ a beautiful day it was!

questions.def: 'Beg' requires past simple in reported speech.
questions.question: She ___ him not to leave.

questions.def: Use 'had' to report past perfect actions further in the past.
questions.question: The document indicated that the meeting ___ been postponed.
